d.ko: Sanzenkai Setsuna awakens on the shore of isolated island Urashima with no memories of his past. Befriending three local girls, Rinne, Karen, and Sara, Setsuna's quest to discover the secrets of Urashima and how they tie into his own past - and future - begins.

d.zh: 随波漂流岛浦岛，记忆丧失的青年-三千界切那。因为怀着要拯救某人的目的，通过拯救被岛上陋习所束缚的少女们而改变未来。在对抗这个岛上流传的陋习的过程中，审视这个岛屿的历史，接开那个巨大的谜团。
